name: polytope
description: Interactive viewer for convex uniform 4D polytopes

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc && npm run copy-assets
scripts.copy-assets: cp src/index.html dist/ && cp src/style.css dist/ && cp -r src/data dist/ && mkdir -p dist/vendor && cp node_modules/three/build/three.module.js node_modules/three/build/three.core.js dist/vendor/
